Take back a perk a person was granted by hand, by the grant's id (grant_...), which 'voidhash person
view' shows beside access granted by hand. Their access ends at once unless something they bought
also gives the perk; purchases are not touched.

Usage:
  voidhash person revoke [person] [grant] [flags]

Arguments:
  person  The person's email, distinct id (the id your app identifies them by) or id
  grant   The grant's id, grant_...

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash person revoke ada@example.com grant_123
  voidhash person revoke person_123 grant_123 --json
